about_short_description.short_description: Ivy Homes provides instant offers and an easy and safe way to sell and buy homes.

product.name: Instant Home Selling Service
product.description: A service that provides homeowners with a preliminary offer for their house within seconds and completes the sale within 15 days after inspection and paperwork.

product.name: Certified Renovated Homes for Sale
product.description: A service offering buyers access to handpicked, legally verified, renovated, and ready-to-move-in homes owned or certified by Ivy Homes.

identifier.value: Real Estate Data-Driven Pricing and Valuation

product.name: Real Estate Data-Driven Pricing and Valuation
product.description: A data-driven pricing service that uses extensive property data and algorithms to determine fair market prices for homes.

product.name: Broker and Agent Partnership Program
product.description: A program that enables brokers and agents to partner with Ivy Homes by selling inventory or finding buyers for Ivy-listed homes, earning commissions.

product.name: End-to-End Home Buying Assistance
product.description: A service that assists buyers throughout the home purchase process, including property selection, legal verification, loan facilitation, and registration.
